messages:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — noticed the new rollout sampling is causing p95 for /v1/generate to flip between ~110ms and ~350ms depending on quota bucket. Anyone else seeing large jumps?
Maya Chen: @Alex Kim seeing something similar in staging. The dashboard percentiles look fine for some endpoints but weird for others. :thinking:
Samir Patel: Can you paste the query you're using to compute the endpoints' percentiles? We recently changed the rollup to use reservoir sampling + bucketed counts.
Alex Kim: Here's the quick snippet I pulled from the exporter that aggregates before sending to TS:
```
# simplified
bucket = hash(client_id) % 128
if bucket < rollout_sample_rate * 128:
    emit_sample(metric)
else:
    incr(bucketed_count)
```
Nora Lee: Ah — we only emit samples, and the dashboard assumes the samples are weighted to reconstruct percentiles. If some routes have lots of un-emitted requests (due to quota gating), the reconstructed distribution is off.
jen-oncall: So the mismatch between 'observed p95' (full traffic) vs 'dashboard p95' (sampled+reconstructed) could be driven by the quota/routing ordering. If routing applies quota before sampling we lose the heavy tails.
Maya Chen: Exactly. In canary we route then sample; in prod we sample then apply quota in the edge layer (different ordering). That explains endpoint splits where SLOs look fine in canary but blow up in prod.
Samir Patel: Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) Make sampling deterministic and happen at the ingress layer before any routing/quotas so sample represents full path. 2) Emit both sampled values and a raw "bucketed_count" metric so dashboard can show sample fraction and confidence.
Alex Kim: I like emitting both. Also we should surface a new meta metric: `sample_coverage` per endpoint+route. Then the UI can gray-out percentiles below threshold.
Nora Lee: For immediate triage I pushed a Grafana panel that overlays raw qps vs sample_qps. It clearly shows sample_qps dropping for some quota buckets at 10:23 UTC. :eyes:
stats-bot: deploy-bot deployed branch fix/dashboard-sample-visibility to staging at 2026-03-17T10:45:12Z
jen-oncall: Can we calculate a cheap correction factor when sample_coverage is high-ish? Like scale counts for percentile estimator when coverage > 0.2 to avoid throwing everything away.
Maya Chen: We could, but correction for percentiles is tricky. Better to make sampling deterministic (hash on request id) so different collectors see the same set. Then weight samples by 1/coverage for histogram reconstruction.
Samir Patel: Implementation notes: change sampling key to `hash(request_id)`, sample rate stored in config service, add counter `hist_sampled_count` and gauge `hist_total_count`. Then change TDigest merge to include weights.
Alex Kim: Is anyone worried about extra cardinality from tagging endpoint+route in those counters? We already explode tags in some dashboards.
Nora Lee: We'll aggregate by route only (not full path) for the coverage metric to reduce cardinality. Keep finer tags only on sampled payloads which are rare.
jen-oncall: Action items:
- Maya: PR to make sampling deterministic at ingress + emit coverage metrics (branch: fix/deterministic-sampling) — please add unit tests for hashing and sampling boundary. (assigned)
- Samir: Update the TDigest merge to accept weights and validate against a full-trace replay on staging. (assigned)
- Alex: Update dashboard panels to show `sample_qps` vs `total_qps` and gray-out percentiles when coverage < 0.1. (assigned)
- Nora: Add a small smoke check that computes p95 from a replayed full-trace and compares to reconstructed p95 nightly.
- jen-oncall: Coordinate rollout and update runbook.
Maya Chen: Filing an issue now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/452 — linking the PR once opened.
Samir Patel: FYI I ran a local replay with 5% deterministic sampling and weight-corrected tdigest — reconstructed p95 within 3% of full p95 for that trace.
Alex Kim: Awesome. Let's keep the short-term band-aid (dashboard visibility) and push the sampling change next week. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
jen-oncall: Adding release note and slack alert for when the sampling rollout hits staging.
stats-bot: metric-alert: sample_coverage for /v1/generate dropped below 0.05 at 2026-03-17T10:23:41Z — routed to #eng-platform
